resources.title: Data Structures & Algorithms Complete Notes
resources.subject: Data Structures
resources.summary: Comprehensive semester notes covering balanced BSTs, graph traversal algorithms (BFS/DFS), shortest paths, and dynamic programming.

resources.title: Operating Systems Architecture & CPU Scheduling
resources.subject: Operating Systems
resources.summary: Detailed explanation of FCFS, SJF, Round Robin, Banker's algorithm, and semaphore sync mechanisms with step-by-step Gantt charts.

resources.title: Database Management Systems & SQL Normalization
resources.subject: DBMS
resources.summary: Step-by-step normalization (1NF–BCNF), relational algebra, transaction ACID properties, indexing, and SQL join queries.

resources.title: Discrete Math & Logic Theory Handout
resources.subject: Discrete Mathematics
resources.summary: Propositional calculus, predicate logic, recurrence relations, graph isomorphism, and combinatorics problem sets.

resources.title: Web Development & Modern REST APIs
resources.subject: Web Development
resources.summary: Comprehensive handbook for React, Node.js backend architecture, authentication, and state management patterns.

resources.title: Computer Networks — TCP/IP & Protocol Stacks
resources.subject: Computer Networks
resources.summary: Layer-by-layer breakdown of TCP/IP vs OSI model, CIDR subnetting, BGP/OSPF routing, and TLS handshakes.

resources.title: Signal Processing — Fourier Transforms & Filtering
resources.subject: Signal Processing
resources.summary: Continuous and discrete Fourier transforms, DFT, FFT, Z-transforms, and digital FIR/IIR filter design methodologies.

resources.title: Thermodynamics — Zeroth to Third Law Applications
resources.subject: Thermodynamics
resources.summary: Carnot heat engines, entropy derivations, Rankine & Brayton power cycles, and steam tables numerical solutions.

resources.title: Structural Analysis — Truss Analysis & Deflections
resources.subject: Structural Analysis
resources.summary: Method of joints, method of sections, Castigliano's theorem, and influence line diagrams for determinate structures.
